This line handles synchronous functions by wrapping them in `run_in_threadpool` using `functools.partial`.

If `func` is already a `functools.partial` object (e.g., `partial(my_func, arg1)`), then `is_async_callable(func)` will likely be `False` (unless `partial` itself is somehow considered async callable, which it isn't), and it will be wrapped in `functools.partial(run_in_threadpool, func)`.     and returns an ASGI application.

    f: Callable[[Request], Awaitable[Response]] = (
